messages:
sasha: Heads up — dependency advisory for libfastcrypto 2.4.9 (CVE-2026-1745). Remote memory disclosure risk. Public disclosure scheduled in 5 days. Affects hosted API, Dedicated GPU runtimes, and modelcache native layer. We need a patch plan. :rotating_light:

dominik: Is there a PoC yet? SLA impact?

sasha: No public PoC seen yet, NVD entry pending. We have scanner hits internally (likely targeted). Upgrade path is 2.5.1 which is ABI-compatible but forces a process restart for the runtime to load new symbols. Expect ~10min warmup per node and ~15% throughput hit while caches repopulate.

maria: For customer tiers: enterprise dedicated clusters need 72h maintenance notice per contract. Hosted customers — we can do rolling patch in low-traffic windows but must call out potential brief latency bump (99.9 -> 99.8 for ~30-60m in aggregate). Is that acceptable to product/legal?

leo: Public exposure risk? If PoC drops before we finish, do we have mitigations to avoid emergency full-stop? :eyes:

sasha: No PoC yet. However, scanners are probing. Recommend prioritizing enterprise+hosted as high. Mitigations: TLS hardening doesn't help here; temporary mitigation is process isolation + iptables block on modelcache external port and strict client auth for internal RPCs.

ashley: Proposed rollout: canary 10% capacity in us-west-2 (low-traffic region) for 2h tonight, monitor tail latencies and error rates; if stable, expand to 30% next night and full roll following day. For Dedicated enterprise, coordinate with account teams for scheduled maintenance on day-of-disclosure (or earlier if customers opt in). Can we do faster?

dominik: SLA side — enterprise contracts require 72h notice. We can still patch earlier but must inform account owners and provide a remediation window. If we unilaterally patch without notice for security, legal may allow but it triggers credit calculations; need legal sign-off.

maria: I'll draft a customer advisory template: summary, affected components, mitigation steps, opt-out instructions, and timeline. Also create support playbook and KB with rollback steps. Will route to legal.

sec-bot: Snyk: found 3 services with libfastcrypto <2.5.1 — hosted-api, embedder, modelcache. See https://snyk.example/issue/CVE-2026-1745

sasha: Modelcache is sticky: native wheel links against libfastcrypto; upgrading requires rebuild of the wheel with the new lib, run perf verification and run E2E model correctness tests. That's ~6-8 hours of CI + canary validation. Not doable in a single night for all regions. Suggest split plan: immediate runtime bump for hosted-api + embedder; schedule modelcache rebuild + canary next week.

leo: If exploit appears earlier, short-term mitigation for modelcache: block incoming external access to modelcache ports and enforce mTLS for internal calls. That avoids a restart and reduces exposure surface.

ashley: Decision checklist for this thread: 1) Publish internal incident advisory and customer advisory draft tomorrow morning; 2) Canary hosted-api in us-west-2 tonight (10% for 2h); 3) If canary OK, widen per proposed cadence; 4) Dedicated enterprise: schedule maintenance in 5 days with account teams (offer opt-in earlier); 5) Modelcache rebuild scheduled next week with validation; 6) Prepare rollback artifacts and runbook. Who takes ownership? :clipboard:

dominik: I'll own canary automation + rollback artifacts and open ticket S-1234 (P0). Assigning to eng-sre and eng-runtime.

maria: I'll own customer comms and the support KB. Will request legal sign-off on the advisory now.

sasha: I'll coordinate builds and modelcache wheel rebuild. Also will prep perf baselines and a script for quick rollback. Example canary deploy commands:```bash
# canary restart hosted-api deployment
kubectl -n redwood rollout restart deployment/hosted-api-canary --namespace=prod-us-west-2
# verify
kubectl -n redwood get pods -l app=hosted-api-canary -o wide
# rebuild wheel (modelcache native)
docker run --rm -v$(pwd):/work -w /work build-image bash -lc "./scripts/build_modelcache_wheel.sh && pip install dist/modelcache-*.whl"```

leo: I'll prepare the temporary iptables rules and mTLS config snippets in a follow-up PR.

ashley: Timeline: Canary tonight, widen if green. Customer advisory draft tomorrow EOD. Dedicated maintenance scheduled for disclosure day unless a customer requests earlier slot. If any sign of PoC, we escalate to incident channel and freeze rollbacks. :thumbsup:

dominik: Ticket S-1234 created, linking this thread and setting SLA impact flag. I'll ping account owners after legal sign-off.

maria: Draft sent to legal for sign-off. Support playbook draft ready; will share in #support this afternoon.

sasha: Will start builds and queue modelcache CI. I'll post status updates here.

sec-bot: Reminder: disclosure countdown 5d 02h 14m (as of this thread). Keep eye on external feed.

ashley: Thanks everyone — action owners assigned. Please post progress updates here and escalate immediately if any PoC shows up. :rocket:
